title: The authority closure — the legacy viewer made impossible, the independent persisted current-generation anchor, the sovereign release chain, and the renderer-success records cross-check
author: Coder 2 (presentation layer)
directive: Operator directive R451-C2.6 (the LAST authority-hardening round before the layer closes: close only the remaining authority-boundary defects; no visual polish, no new model, no Coder-1 modification, no benchmark expansion; add no more than the decisive tests; verify and stop). Acceptance gate: R451-C2.6.
round_question: Can the presentation boundary still be reached through a legacy payload's convincing viewerUrl, through an artifact that anchors its own current generation, through a diagnostic filename with a complete set of presentation artifacts, or through two renderer-success records that contradict each other — and still claim visual readiness?
answer: NO — measured: a legacy payload's only surface is the explicit non-current compatibility hero (the rendering order itself makes the viewer unmountable, proven in a real browser against the production build); the current generation is anchored by the INDEPENDENT persisted DESIGN_LINEAGE.json current-generation entry and the artifact generation never anchors itself (a missing anchor fails closed at every boundary); verify_release_chain independently certifies the canonical artifact through the persisted identity chain (a caller path and the diagnostic locator can never satisfy a rung); and the receipt's and the render record's success statuses must agree (the production writer copies one from the other, so disagreement is tampering — fail closed).

req_2_independent_persisted_current_gene.what: THE ONE canonical persisted current-generation source is DEFINED (C2.6 §2): DESIGN_LINEAGE.json's current-generation entry — its own generation_id when recorded, else its recorded generation number normalized through the pipeline's own gen-<n> convention. The C2.5-era fallback that anchored the current generation with the persisted identity's own generation_id when the lineage recorded none is SUPERSEDED (Art. LXIV): current_generation = artifact_generation is never inferred. The triple identity is mandatory — artifact generation == receipt generation == the independent persisted current generation. A MISSING anchor fails closed at every boundary: the certification never completes (geometry_unverified + UNKNOWN authority + the join undecided), and the release chain's generation rung fails (RELEASE_UNVERIFIED class). The contract surfaces current_generation_anchor and independent_current_generation_anchor_present verbatim; a projection generation contradicting the ANCHOR (not only the identity) also fails closed.

req_3_verify_release_chain_sovereign.what: verify_release_chain IS SOVEREIGN (C2.6 §3): rung 1 independently obtains the CERTIFIED canonical artifact through certified_canonical_glb — the persisted identity chain, the measured SHA, the generation against the independent anchor, and the structural container proof. The caller-provided glb_path is a DIAGNOSTIC cross-check only: agreement is recorded, disagreement FAILS CLOSED ('a caller path is a diagnostic and never weakens the persisted-identity requirement'), and the diagnostic locator's filename fallbacks never satisfy a rung. Rung 1's detail names the certification basis. Rung names are unchanged (canonical_glb_identity, invocation_receipt_identity, generation_identity, render_record_identity, gate_pass, presentation_artifact_set, hero_exists, hero_source_identity) — the comment numbering was corrected (the pre-existing 'rung 4/rung 4' comment typo).

req_4_renderer_success_records_cross_che.what: The renderer-success records must AGREE (C2.6 §4): receipt.invocation_status == render_record.status, enforced inside the chain's render_record_identity rung. The production receipt writer copies the record's status verbatim (visual_compiler.py: invocation_status = record.status), so any disagreement between the two success records is tampering or forgery — the rung fails closed. Neither contradiction (receipt OK / record FAILED, or receipt RENDER_FAILED / record OK, both over a COMPLETE_PASS gate) can produce VISUAL_READY: the first fails the chain (RELEASE_UNVERIFIED, JOIN_FAILURE_OBSERVED on the watchdog), the second is blocked by the receipt side (RENDER_BLOCKED) AND caught by the same rung when the chain is evaluated directly.

req_5_preserved_strong_controls.what: Everything C2.5 delivered is preserved and re-proven: projection identity sovereignty (the forged geom.artifact_identity still certifies nothing — C2.5 battery re-run green), the structural GLB check (unchanged), the legacy payload rule (LEGACY_STATE_UNAVAILABLE, now with the rendering-order lock on top), the absolute VISUAL_READY authority invariant (visual_complete + ENGINEERING, source-pinned, re-asserted), the watchdog's dual reporting (observed_join_state + watchdog_verdict, version disclosure bumped to R451-C2.6; no second state machine — it consumes THE evaluator), the typed join vocabulary (closed at ten states), and the fail-closed release chain (now sovereign). The positive controls keep working: the fully valid fresh chain reaches geometry_available + ENGINEERING + VISUAL_READY + 'Technology ready', and the watchdog PASSes it.
